01Our story

An idea deserves
a little movement.

Good products have stories worth telling. But turning a product into a polished animation can mean juggling tools, learning complicated timelines, and doing hours of manual work.

Vekto began with a simpler question: what if the path from an idea to a visual result felt more direct?

Founded in 2026 by Abhay Solanki, Vekto is an independently built SaaS platform exploring that question—one workflow, experiment, and iteration at a time.

02What is Vekto?

Your browser.
Your product story.

Vekto is being built to make product visuals, animation, and product storytelling easier for creators, founders, developers, and product teams.

The current focus is a simpler browser-based workflow for creating polished animated visuals. The longer-term direction is an AI-native experience that helps turn what you describe into something you can preview, refine, and use.

Create with clarity

A more direct path from an idea to a visual, without unnecessary complexity.

Keep creative control

Experiment with the details. Refine the motion until it tells your story.

Build toward automation

A future where prompts and developer workflows can help bring ideas to life.

03Why we are building it

Strong products need
strong visual stories.

Product launches. Landing pages. Social media. A demo that makes a feature click. Modern products need movement to explain what they do and why it matters.

Creating that movement should feel approachable. Vekto aims to reduce the complexity, first through a simpler interface and eventually through natural-language AI workflows.

  • Product launches
  • Landing pages
  • Marketing
  • Social media
  • Product demonstrations
  • Documentation
  • Developer tools
  • Startup launches
04Where Vekto is going
LONG-TERM VISION · NOT A RELEASED WORKFLOW

What if animation started
with a conversation?

Describe an idea. See it take shape. Refine it in your own words.

“Create a smooth product reveal animation where the dashboard fades in, the cards slide upward, and the main CTA appears at the end.”

Traditional workflow

  1. 01Idea
  2. 02Design
  3. 03Timeline
  4. 04Manual animation
  5. 05Export

The Vekto vision

  1. 01Prompt
  2. 02AI
  3. 03Animation
  4. 04Refine
  5. 05Export

The goal is for Vekto to understand the intent behind your prompt and help generate an animation. Then, instead of manually rebuilding each step, you could keep refining through conversation.

  • ↳“Make the animation slower.”
  • ↳“Move the cards closer together.”
  • ↳“Change the entrance animation.”
  • ↳“Add a subtle spring effect.”
  • ↳“Make the final transition smoother.”

This is our future direction. The complete prompt-to-animation workflow is not available today.

05Developer workflows
FUTURE ROADMAP

Vekto CLI.
Motion, in your workflow.

One future direction is a developer-focused CLI that brings AI-powered animation generation into development workflows.

Designed toward integration with models such as Claude and GPT, it could let developers and creators generate or modify animation projects programmatically through natural-language prompts.

The vision: connect AI reasoning with animation creation, with Vekto as the bridge between an idea and an animation.

VEKTO CLICONCEPT PREVIEW

// A future conversational workflow

you › Create a product launch animation for this dashboard.

// Claude or GPT interprets the intent

you › Make the hero animation more cinematic.

you › Add a 500ms delay before the cards appear.

you › Make the transition smoother.

you › Export this as a reusable animation.

// Roadmap concept. No released CLI commands.

The proposed CLI pipeline

  1. 01Natural language
  2. 02AI model
  3. 03Animation logic
  4. 04Vekto
  5. 05Generated animation
06AI-native animation

Understand the intent.
Keep the creator.

Our future vision is an intelligent layer that understands what you want an animation to do. Integrations with models such as Claude and GPT could translate that intent into structured instructions Vekto can execute.

That could make animation more accessible to people without advanced motion-design skills, while keeping the final creative decisions in their hands.

A potential future workflow, not a claim of currently released AI integrations.

  1. 01

    Describe

    Tell Vekto what you want to animate.

  2. 02

    Interpret

    Claude or GPT interprets your request.

  3. 03

    Structure

    AI turns intent into animation instructions.

  4. 04

    Execute

    Vekto executes those instructions.

  5. 05

    Preview

    See the animation and decide what works.

  6. 06

    Refine

    Ask for changes in natural language.

  7. 07

    Update

    Vekto updates the animation accordingly.

08Our current stage
ACTIVELY BEING BUILT

Where we are today.

Vekto was founded in 2026. It is an early-stage, independently built product, not yet funded.

Today, the focus is building the core product experience, improving the animation workflow, experimenting with AI-assisted creation, and learning how creators and developers want to work with animation.

There is still a lot to build. Feedback and real use will help shape what comes next.

09A note from the founder

Built from the ground up.

Vekto is being built from the ground up with a simple belief: creating great product visuals should not require a complicated workflow.

I’m building Vekto as a solo founder, working across engineering, product, design, and experimentation.

The long-term goal is to combine the flexibility of modern animation tooling with the intelligence of AI, so that creating and refining animations can become as simple as describing what you want.

There is still a lot to build, but that is what makes the process exciting.

Abhay SolankiFounder, Vekto
